title: Retinoic Acid Alleviates Accelerated Atherosclerosis in Diesel Exhaust-Derived PM2.5-Exposed ApoE-/- Mice by Enhancing eNOS-NO Coupling.
snippet: Respiratory exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), including diesel exhaust particles (DEPs), is a major air pollutant associated with pulmonary inflammation and cardiovascular diseases. title: Mitochondrial DNA Abnormalities in Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathies: Innate Immune Signaling and Therapeutic Prospects.
snippet: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encodes essential components of oxidative phosphorylation and can stimulate innate immunity when released from mitochondria. Its genetic and immunological functions provide a rationale for investigating mtDNA abnormalities in idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIMs), where muscle dysfunction and inflammation coexist.
